inputs.text: Health workers in Nigeria are bravely standing up against entrenched inequality and structural neglect in the health system, protesting reforms that would only strengthen top-down institutional power while ignoring the needs of frontline staff and the vulnerable communities they serve. On Thursday, the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations gathered at the Unity Fountain in Maitama in Abuja to challenge these bills before the National Assembly. This resistance is a vital pushback by essential workers against policies that weaken unions and perpetuate the exploitation of those delivering care, rather than addressing the historical inequities that leave ordinary people behind.
